status: PROPOSAL ONLY: no trainer implemented, source cohort selected, teacher requested or model called by this design
prerequisite: Actual NF4 authored full generation must work and be parseable. Freeze implementation, tests, data exclusions and protocol before source intake; independent review before root-owned software backward and training dispatch.
hypothesis: A small decoder LoRA can improve learned immediate board-fact explanations and legal native3ply continuations over the same frozen NF4 publisher-weight baseline. Fixed supervised prose establishes a bounded fact/continuation experiment; it does not establish open-ended strategic coaching quality.
preserve: Original publisher assets and BF16 candidate/partial resource failure
Executed NF4v1/v2 sources and all passed/failed software receipts
Unadapted NF4v2 actual baseline on the exact future heldout inputs
No full-weights save or redistribution; save only the separately identified LoRA and optimizer/checkpoint metadata

native_format_findings.data: Official standardized fields are fen, history, prompt, response and extra. LC0 sees only fen/history. Evaluator extra is carried outside the model.
native_format_findings.tokenization: Use pinned tokenizer.apply_chat_template for user+assistant with enable_thinking=False. Verify exact generation-prefix equality, mask the full user/assistant-prefix span to-100, supervise response and closing/EOS tokens. Do not silently truncate targets or train a prefix-only answer.
native_format_findings.prompt: Use exact existing prompt_for(currentFEN, optional selectedUCI) for paired task variants; no target/prose/PV/engine fields enter the prompt.
native_format_findings.output: Native headings ANALYSIS, BEST_MOVE, CRITICAL_LINE, PROMISING_MOVES, EVALUATION with root-POV piece and square tokens. Correct captures, en passant, castling and promotion must replay and round-trip under the existing strict parser.
native_format_findings.training_forward: Use the pinned official Flamingo manual hidden-state walk with the same full merged128333 vocabulary. Construct with n_new_tokens=0 and lora_rank=0 so a pre-injected LoRA is not refrozen or doubled. Replace its meta-created bridges with actual frozen pinned BF16 bridges; optimize only validated LoRA names.
native_format_findings.checkpointing: Official manual rl_activation_checkpointing wraps each bridge+decoder-layer closure with use_reentrant=False and preserve_rng_state=False. Use LoRA dropout0, disable duplicate HF-layer checkpointing, keep model use_cache=False. Frozen bridge operations must remain in autograd to transmit gradients to earlier LoRA layers; only the frozen encoder runs under no_grad.
native_format_findings.loss: Shifted next-token cross entropy across the entire128333 unmasked vocabulary, assistant/EOS tokens only. Use official chunked LM-head loss with logit_chunk_size32 and FP32 CE accumulation. No legal-token masking or teacher-forced loss may be substituted for raw generated evaluation.

memory_traps: Native generate() is inference_mode and cannot be reused as a training forward.

Installed PEFT0.21.2 prepare_model_for_kbit_training casts every non-Params4bit BF16/FP16 PARAMETER toFP32, including the tied128333x2048 embedding/head. That alone adds525651968bytes; calling it on the combined Queen wrapper also upcasts frozen bridges. Propose explicit reviewed equivalent preparation: freeze all base params, retain BF16 embedding/head/bridges, retain existing stable native norms, inject FP32 trainable LoRA only and use nonreentrant manual checkpointing. Do not call the generic bulk-upcast helper blindly.
Calling Flamingo with lora_rank<0 after injecting PEFT freezes the LoRA. Positive rank would inject another adapter. Constructor rank0 plus exact named trainable inventory avoids both.

Hooks installed only for a forward and removed before checkpoint backward can omit conditioning on recomputation. The official manual closure explicitly includes each bridge inside its checkpoint; prefer that for training, then independently verify zero-adapter/manual/native equality.
Generic .to(dtype) on the combined quantized model can corrupt quantization/tied weights or create host allocations. Preserve explicit cuda0 Params4bit and stable target-only BF16 component loader.

Do not keep all corpus hidden states or logits in RAM, use optimizer foreach=False to avoid large temporary lists, and do not use generation KV cache, torch.compile, Triton/Liger, offload or package upgrades in this first run.

candidate_trainable_spec.trainable_inventory_gate: Exactly q/v LoRA A/B matrices in all36layers, no other gradients or optimizer parameters; verify nonzero finite adapter gradients and actual changed saved adapter after root smoke.

source.rights: CC0-1.0 retained294920084-byte Lichess source; no further acquisition

new_data_proposal.selection: Deterministic source order, first original setup ply only. One root per canonical original game. Source solutions/themes/tails discarded before model or engine use. Split assignment by predeclared original-game hash.
new_data_proposal.exclusions: Union all historical game/FEN registries plus every current v5/v6 root including unused reservoirs, balanced-v2 all splits, all encoder-head TRAIN/dev/newheld roots, all96Queen benchmark roots, all authored/UI fixtures and any newer root cohort created before freeze. Exclude before/current and retained successor boards. Bind exact manifests and computed complete union before intake.
new_data_proposal.paired_train_tasks: Two records per train game: currentFEN only best-move/analysis, and currentFEN+Stockfish selected legal move explanation. Both remain in TRAIN; equal deterministic sampling. Selected-given BEST_MOVE copying is reported separately and is not move-prediction evidence.

development.rule: After retained teachers, earliest64 roots with3legally replayable nonterminal PV plies. First16 of those fixed before any model call serve raw generation selection; all64 support response-token NLL. Retain every reservoir rejection/error/unused eligible row.

fresh_heldout.rule: Earliest128 complete legal3-PV roots chosen before any learned call. If insufficient, stop and retain insufficient cohort rather than adapt reservoir. These measures apply to3-ply-eligible tactical roots and explicitly exclude short/mate-in1 reference roots.

new_data_proposal.teacher: Reuse reviewed streaming same-event score/PV and final-bestmove coherence. Stockfish50knodes,1thread/worker,32MBhash, at most6CPUworkers chosen before launch from frozen resource policy. Durable create-only intent/chunk journals preserve all actual requests/failures; no hidden relabel attempt.
new_data_proposal.input_seal: Label-free current FEN/actual validated history/optional selected UCI only. No PV, postboard, score, gives_check, reply or evaluator labels in generator inputs or board encoder. Separate target/evaluator files with bound identities.
new_data_proposal.verified_target: Bounded fluent ANALYSIS states actual mover/source/destination, capture/en-passant/promotion/castling facts, gives-check/checkmate and exact checking pieces when present. Native BEST_MOVE/CRITICAL_LINE/PROMISING_MOVES use teacher bestmove and verified3-PV prefix, stopping at automatic game over. EVALUATION may supervise coherent bounded Stockfish score as an uncertain learned estimate. No unsupported fork/plan/positional advantage prose or external LLM teacher.
new_data_proposal.target_quality: CPU-round-trip every native move, every immediate fact and complete EOS-bearing tokenization≤512total tokens. Freeze deterministic short prose before intake; reject/retain malformed rows without replacing selected games based on model performance. No silent truncation.
new_data_proposal.encoder_work: Current-FEN encoder only, no_grad, online bounded batch1. Optional dedup/cache is a later separate implementation choice requiring an explicit label-free cache contract; do not change frozen method midrun.

training_budget_proposal.schedule: 16update linear warmup then cosine to10percent LR
training_budget_proposal.resource_policy: Keep current NF4 start6GiBphysical/10GiBcommit/10GiBGPU and stop4GiBphysical/4GiBcommit/1GiBGPU; same read-only sampling/cancel guard. Check before every microbatch and after backward/optimizer; shared root-owned lease/Windows job. Any backend/resource failure stops further model calls; retain terminal failure and all pending denominators.
training_budget_proposal.time_budget: Graceful walltime exit may retain completed scheduled checkpoints as a predeclared partial run, with actual updates/presentations explicit. A resource/backend failure does not trigger a resumed or silently lower-resource heldout run.
training_budget_proposal.software_gate_first: After CPU/source review, root-only4TRAIN-record forward/backward/update smoke under a separate optimizer/checkpoint condition. Verify nonzero finite LoRA gradients/change, no base/bridge gradient/change, input-only NF4 backward and zero-adapter equality. Discard smoke adapter and fresh-seed optimizer for actual run. Root software throughput/peak commit determine whether the frozen full run is feasible before any heldout model call.

dev_only_selection_proposal.conditions: Same NF4 unadapted checkpoint0 plus each completed scheduled adapter; no fresh-heldout content inspected for selection.
dev_only_selection_proposal.raw_selector: On fixed16development roots run both selected/unselected modes, max384newtokens/120s each, deterministic no_cache/math. Preserve32denominator and all finish/parse failures.
ordering: Most complete responses with strict valid bestmove, legal3ply line and all requested immediate facts correct on fixed raw-dev rows
Most exact3ply teacher-prefix agreements in unselected mode
Lowest mean supervised response/EOS NLL over all128paired dev records
dev_only_selection_proposal.baseline_candidate: Checkpoint0 remains eligible and wins any tie; save selection with model/data/source hashes before heldout generation.

fresh_evaluation_proposal.conditions: Unadapted NF4 baseline and saved selected adapter once on each128fresh roots in both modes; order predeclared. Full512 planned generated responses retained.
fresh_evaluation_proposal.limits: Same384tokens/120s no_cache/math in both conditions. Invalid/missing/illegal/truncated outputs count in full denominators; never rule/engine-repair moves.
reports: Immediate-fact exact counts and every error category, selected/unselected modes separately
Strict structured-output completion and3ply raw legality counts
Independent unselected first/2/3-prefix agreement with50knode root reference on128eligible roots
Selected-given firstmove consistency separately;2/3-ply continuation agreement may be measured but must not be called unprompted move prediction
Full raw text/token IDs, source/model hashes, timing/peak commit/GPU and all notrun/unknown/failure reasons
fresh_evaluation_proposal.guardrails: Teacher agreement is not chess correctness or Elo. Mechanically generated targets support a bounded factuality/continuation claim only. Coach-facing quality still needs blind expert inspection of actual unseen outputs; no promotion based on fluent templates or training loss alone.
